name: 11024 · Great Neck, NY
findings: ZIP 11024 (Great Neck) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11024 (Great Neck) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11024 (Great Neck) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
